issues.t: Wipers can quit working (recall)
issues.sym: The windshield wipers stop or work only on and off, often in heavy use.
issues.why: The contacts inside the wiper motor's circuit breaker can become contaminated and stop passing current. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Do not drive in rain or snow without working wipers. Check your VIN for recall 97V-026 and have the wiper motor checked.

issues.t: Fuel tank can crack from evaporative system fault (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell around the rear of the car or fuel dripping near the tank.
issues.why: A problem in the evaporative emissions system can put stress on the fuel tank until it cracks. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Do not drive or park indoors if you smell fuel. Check your VIN for recall 00V-314 and have the tank inspected.

issues.t: Front subframe rusts through in salt states (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front end over bumps, wandering steering, or visible heavy rust on the frame under the engine.
issues.why: Road salt and water can corrode the front sub-frame until it weakens. Hyundai recalled cars in salt-belt states.
issues.next: Have the front subframe inspected right away and stop driving if it is badly corroded. Check your VIN for recall 09V-124.

issues.t: Side airbag warning light and side airbags may not deploy (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light stays on, often after adjusting or sliding the front seats.
issues.why: The side airbag wiring harness under the seat can be damaged or lose connection, which turns on the warning light and can keep the side airbag from working. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Have the airbag system checked soon. Check your VIN for recalls 01V-347 and 02V-105.

issues.t: Engine can stall from mass airflow sensor wiring (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls or runs rough while driving, sometimes with a check engine light.
issues.why: The wiring to the mass airflow sensor can make poor contact and cut the signal the engine needs to run. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Avoid highway driving until checked, since stalling is a crash risk. Check your VIN for recall 00V-259.

issues.t: Fuel tank valve may not close (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell, trouble filling the tank, or fuel spilling after a fill-up.
issues.why: A valve on the fuel tank may not close properly. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Do not overfill the tank and check your VIN for recalls 04V-178 and 04V-369.

issues.t: Brake light switch faults (recalls)
issues.sym: Brake lights stay off or stay on, cruise control will not switch off, the shifter will not leave Park, or it leaves Park without pressing the brake.
issues.why: The stop lamp switch at the brake pedal can malfunction, and on 2011-2012 cars a rubber stopper pad at the pedal can break down and hold the switch in the wrong position. Hyundai ran several recalls for this.
issues.next: Ask someone to watch your brake lights while you press the pedal. Check your VIN for recalls 09V-280, 09V-122, 13V-113 and 15V-759.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may switch off for small adults (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger AIRBAG OFF light stays lit with an adult in the seat, or an airbag warning light comes on.
issues.why: The seat sensor that decides who is sitting in the passenger seat can mistake a small adult for a child and turn off the airbag. Hyundai recalled cars for reprogramming and seat cushion repair.
issues.next: Have the system checked and check your VIN for recall 08V-161. Until fixed, a small adult passenger may not be protected by the airbag.

issues.t: Rear crossmember rust can let a control arm break loose (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, the car darting or pulling suddenly, or heavy rust on the rear frame piece.
issues.why: Road salt and water can get inside the rear crossmember and rust it from within until a rear control arm mount fails. Hyundai recalled cars from salt-belt states.
issues.next: Stop driving if the rear end feels loose and have it towed. Check your VIN for recall 13V-354.

issues.t: Water in ABS module can short and overheat (recall)
issues.sym: ABS and brake warning lights, or a burning smell from the engine bay.
issues.why: Water can get into the ABS control module and cause an electrical short. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 18V-026 and park outdoors until it is repaired.

issues.t: Stability control may brake a wheel on its own (recall)
issues.sym: The car pulls or slows unexpectedly during a turn with the stability light flashing.
issues.why: The electronic stability control could apply the outside front brake when it was not needed. Hyundai recalled early cars for a fix.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 05V-316 and have the stability system checked.

issues.t: Throttle sensor codes and cold idle surge
issues.sym: Check engine light with throttle codes such as P2135 or P0638, idle that rises and falls on cold starts, or reduced power.
issues.why: The throttle position sensor in the electronic throttle body can give bad readings, and carbon buildup can make the throttle stick. Hyundai issued bulletins to replace the sensor, update the computer and clean the throttle body.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the shop to check the Hyundai throttle bulletins before replacing parts.

issues.t: V6 timing chain tensioner rattle
issues.sym: A rattle from the front of the engine for a few seconds after a cold start.
issues.why: The timing chain tensioner on the V6 can be slow to build pressure. Hyundai updated the part and later revised the replacement steps.
issues.next: Have it checked if the rattle lasts or gets longer. Keep oil changes on time, since low or old oil makes it worse.

issues.t: Automatic transmission range switch and solenoid codes
issues.sym: Check engine light, harsh or late shifts, or the transmission stuck in one gear.
issues.why: The gear range switch and shift solenoids can send faulty signals. Hyundai issued bulletins covering these codes and a computer update to improve downshifts.
issues.next: Have the codes read soon. If the car stays in one gear, drive gently to a shop.

issues.t: Theta II engine knocking and seizure
issues.sym: A metallic knock that gets faster with engine speed, an oil pressure or check engine light (often code P1326), loss of power, or the engine stalling.
issues.why: Machining debris and bearing wear in these engines can starve the rod bearings of oil. Hyundai recalled many of them, added knock-detection software, and extended engine coverage.
issues.next: Pull over and stop if you hear a knock or lose power. Check your VIN for the engine recall, software update, and extended warranty.

issues.t: Excessive oil consumption
issues.sym: Oil needs topping up between changes, blue smoke, or a catalytic converter code.
issues.why: These direct-injection engines can burn oil, which is often an early sign of the same bearing wear behind engine failures.
issues.next: Check the oil every fill-up and keep service records. Ask a dealer for an oil consumption test if it is dropping fast.

issues.t: Fuel leak in the engine bay, often after engine replacement (recalls)
issues.sym: A raw fuel smell in or around the engine bay, often after the engine was replaced.
issues.why: The high-pressure fuel pipe may not have been tightened properly during engine replacement, and on 2013-2014 cars a low-pressure fuel hose can crack. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Check your VIN for recalls 18V-934 and 22V-312.

issues.t: Turbo oil feed pipe leak
issues.sym: Oil spots under the car or oil on the plastic engine undercover.
issues.why: The oil feed pipe to the turbocharger can seep oil. Hyundai ran a service campaign to replace the pipe.
issues.next: Have the leak checked and ask a dealer whether the oil feed pipe campaign applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Airbags may not deploy in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: Often no symptom; an airbag warning light may come on.
issues.why: The airbag control unit can be damaged by an electrical short during a crash and stop the front airbags and seat belt pretensioners from working. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 18V-137 and have it repaired.

issues.t: Front seat belt can come loose from its anchor (recalls)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom; the belt may look or feel loose at its lower anchor.
issues.why: The link between the front seat belt and its pretensioner anchor can detach, so the belt may not hold you in a crash. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 17V-152 and 17V-617 and have them done soon.

issues.t: Shift cable can detach and car may roll away (recall)
issues.sym: The gear shown on the dash does not match the shifter, the car will not go into gear, or it moves after being put in Park.
issues.why: The transmission shift cable can come off the shift lever. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake until repaired. Check your VIN for recall 14V-434.

issues.t: 6-speed automatic harsh shifts or slipping
issues.sym: Delayed or harsh engagement into Drive or Reverse, flaring between gears, or a check engine light for incorrect gear ratio.
issues.why: Clutch wear and solenoid or wiring faults in the 6-speed automatic can upset shifting. Hyundai issued several bulletins for diagnosis and repair.
issues.next: Have the codes read and the fluid level checked soon. Ask the dealer about the Hyundai transmission bulletins for your car.

issues.t: Clunk or click when steering
issues.sym: A clunk or click felt in the wheel when turning, mostly at slow speeds.
issues.why: A rubber coupler in the electric power steering wears out. Hyundai extended coverage of the part.
issues.next: Have it inspected and ask a dealer about the extended coverage.

issues.t: Loss of power steering assist or steering shaft faults (recalls)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly becomes heavy, a power steering warning light, or loose or clunky steering.
issues.why: The electric power steering control unit can be damaged, and on early cars the steering shaft joints may not have been assembled correctly. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Drive carefully to a dealer if steering gets heavy or loose. Check your VIN for recalls 16V-190 and 10V-426.

issues.t: Front coil spring can break
issues.sym: A loud bang or clunk from the front, the car sitting lower on one corner, or a tire that gets cut.
issues.why: Road salt can corrode the front coil springs until they snap, and a broken spring can puncture the tire. Hyundai recalled some 2011 cars and extended coverage on the springs.
issues.next: Do not drive on a broken spring. Check your VIN for recall 15V-629 and ask about the spring coverage extension.

issues.t: Brake fluid leak at brake line fittings (recall)
issues.sym: Brake warning light, a soft pedal, longer stopping distances, or fluid near a wheel.
issues.why: Brake line connections may not seal properly and can leak fluid. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Do not drive with a soft pedal or brake light on. Check your VIN for recall 14V-433.

issues.t: Panoramic sunroof glass can shatter
issues.sym: A loud bang overhead and broken glass in the sunroof.
issues.why: The panoramic sunroof glass can break without anything hitting it. Hyundai extended coverage on the glass.
issues.next: Keep the shade closed and have the glass replaced. Ask a dealer about the sunroof coverage extension.

issues.t: Hybrid ABS unit can short and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: ABS and traction warning lights together, a burning plastic smell, or smoke from the engine bay.
issues.why: Brake fluid can leak inside the ABS control unit and cause a short, even when the car is off. Hyundai recalled affected hybrids.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 23V-651 and park outdoors away from buildings until repaired.

issues.t: Theft risk on key-start models without immobilizer
issues.sym: Broken steering column trim, a damaged ignition, or the car being stolen.
issues.why: Key-start Sonatas without a factory immobilizer were targeted by a widely shared theft method. Hyundai offers a free anti-theft software upgrade for eligible cars.
issues.next: Have a Hyundai dealer check whether your VIN qualifies for the free upgrade, and consider a steering wheel lock.

issues.t: Front brake caliper can crack (recall)
issues.sym: Grinding or clunking when braking, the car pulling, or reduced braking.
issues.why: A front brake caliper may fracture. Hyundai recalled early cars and told owners not to drive them until repaired.
issues.next: Do not drive the car until a dealer confirms recall 14V-368 is done.

issues.t: Left front axle shaft may separate (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or vibration from the front, then a sudden loss of drive power.
issues.why: Some cars were built with the wrong left axle shaft, which can come apart. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 14V-784 and have it repaired before driving far.

issues.t: Sunroof panel can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: Wind noise or rattling from the sunroof, or the glass panel lifting.
issues.why: The wind deflector bonding can fail and let the sunroof glass detach while driving. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Keep the sunroof closed and check your VIN for recall 16V-726.

issues.t: Parking brake warning light may not come on (recall)
issues.sym: The parking brake light stays off even when the parking brake is set.
issues.why: Corrosion in the parking brake switch can stop the dash warning from working, so you may drive off with the brake on. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 17V-359 and always release the parking brake by feel until fixed.

issues.t: Turn signal may flash the wrong direction (recall)
issues.sym: The opposite turn signal flashes from the one you selected.
issues.why: A software fault in the body control can light the wrong signal and mislead other drivers. Hyundai recalled affected cars for a software update.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-749 and have the update done.

issues.t: Trunk cannot be opened from inside (recall)
issues.sym: The glow-in-the-dark trunk release inside the trunk does not open the lid.
issues.why: The trunk latch base can be damaged so the inside emergency release does not work. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-619 and have the latch replaced.

issues.t: Remote parking assist may not stop the car (recall)
issues.sym: The car keeps moving during remote smart parking assist instead of stopping.
issues.why: A software fault can keep the remote parking feature from stopping the car when it should. Hyundai recalled affected cars for an update.
issues.next: Do not use remote parking until updated. Check your VIN for recall 20V-213.

issues.t: Trunk may not open from inside (recall)
issues.sym: The inside trunk release does not open the trunk lid.
issues.why: The trunk latch can keep the lid from opening from inside. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-196 and have the latch repaired.

issues.t: Fuel tank can melt near the exhaust (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell, fuel dripping under the car, or a check engine light.
issues.why: A damaged check valve lets air into the fuel tank so it swells against hot exhaust parts and can melt and leak. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Stop driving and have it towed if you smell fuel. Check your VIN for recall 25V-796.

issues.t: High-pressure fuel pump pipe leak (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell in or around the engine bay.
issues.why: The pipe at the high-pressure fuel pump can leak fuel near hot engine parts. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Check your VIN for recall 21V-524.

issues.t: Transmission oil pump fault can cause loss of drive (recall)
issues.sym: Transmission warning, limp mode, or the car suddenly losing power to the wheels.
issues.why: A transmission oil pump malfunction can disable the backup limp mode and lead to a complete loss of drive power. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-746 right away. If the transmission warning comes on, pull over safely.

issues.t: Electric oil pump controller can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from the engine bay, sometimes with warning lights.
issues.why: Damaged parts in the controller for the idle stop and go electric oil pump can overheat and start a fire, even when parked. Hyundai recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Park outside away from buildings until repaired. Check your VIN for recall 23V-526.

issues.t: Brake lights may flash or not light properly (recall)
issues.sym: Brake lights flicker or fail to come on when you press the pedal.
issues.why: A software fault can keep the brake lights from working correctly. Hyundai recalled affected cars for an update.
issues.next: Have someone check your brake lights and check your VIN for recall 24V-583.

issues.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The digital gauge cluster goes dark, so speed and warning lights are not shown.
issues.why: A software fault can make the instrument display fail. Hyundai recalled affected cars for an update.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-047 and have the software updated.

issues.t: Side airbags can go off without a crash (recall)
issues.sym: A side airbag fires after a hard door slam or a knock to the side of the car.
issues.why: The side impact sensors can be too sensitive to sideways jolts.
issues.next: Run the VIN through the Hyundai or NHTSA recall lookup and book the free recall repair if it is still open.

issues.t: Chrome inside door handles can turn sharp (recall)
issues.sym: The plating on an inside door handle flakes or peels and leaves an edge that can cut a finger.
issues.why: The chrome layer wears through and lifts.
issues.next: Have a Hyundai dealer replace the handles free under the recall when convenient, and avoid the rough edge until then.

issues.t: Driver airbag may not inflate fully (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing in normal driving.
issues.why: Some driver airbag inflators were built without a chemical needed for the second stage to fire.
issues.next: Run the VIN through the Hyundai or NHTSA recall lookup and book the free recall repair if it is still open.

issues.t: ABS warning light may stay off during a fault (recall)
issues.sym: No ABS light even though the anti-lock brakes are not working; wheels may lock in a hard stop.
issues.why: The instrument cluster may fail to show the ABS warning.
issues.next: Run the VIN through the Hyundai or NHTSA recall lookup and book the free recall repair if it is still open.

issues.t: Windshield may not be bonded properly (recall)
issues.sym: Wind noise or a water leak around the windshield, or nothing at all.
issues.why: The adhesive holding the windshield may not have bonded, so the glass could come out in a crash.
issues.next: Run the VIN through the Hyundai or NHTSA recall lookup and book the free recall repair if it is still open.
